_comment: AGIBar token proxy — OpenAI-compatible client config. base_url must end with /v1.

all_models: Reasoning models: reasoning_tokens are billed inside max_tokens. Small budgets return finish_reason=length with EMPTY content. Verified: max_tokens=10 -> 0/3 usable replies on both deepseek-v4-flash and MiniMax-M3.1-Flash.
/v1/embeddings -> 403: key allowlist contains only the 3 chat models.
k3.1-pro is quota-gated by the upstream Kimi membership (5-hour window) and intermittently returns 429.
model_limits.k3.1-pro: Rejects any temperature other than 1 (400). Reasoning overhead measured at 250-310 tokens per short reply, so max_tokens<800 returns empty or truncated content (max_tokens=300 gave 12 chars once, empty another time). Non-streaming only: first CONTENT delta arrives at 11.2s while reasoning deltas stream from 3.6s.

capabilities.note: Do not use for classification / short-verdict workloads that cap max_tokens around 10.

blocking_findings: backend/ai/safety.py classifier runs lite=True + max_tokens=10 + temperature=0.0 and treats an EMPTY verdict as safe (`safe = "UNSAFE" not in verdict`). With AGIBar every classifier call returned empty content, so the safety gate silently passed 100% of content. Reproduced end-to-end.
No embedding endpoint (403), so chat and embedding must be split via settings.embedding_provider.
closenai_backend.kept_code_change: backend/config.py + backend/ai/llm.py now support settings.embedding_provider (empty = follow llm_provider, B12 semantics unchanged). Useful for any future chat-only proxy.
closenai_backend.if_retried: Set LLM_PROVIDER=openai and uncomment the OPENAI_* block in backend/.env, AND raise the safety classifier budget (or switch it to a non-reasoning model) first. Otherwise the safety gate does not exist.

k3_as_custom_model.how: OPENAI_PRO_MODEL=k3.1-pro + explicit caller opt-in via llm.complete(model=get_pro_model())
k3_as_custom_model.enforcement: backend/ai/llm.py MODEL_CONSTRAINTS['k3.1-pro'] = {drop_temperature, min_max_tokens: 800, streaming: false}. Only applies when the model id is passed explicitly; the default lite/main path is untouched.
k3_as_custom_model.verified_live: complete(model='k3.1-pro', max_tokens=10, temperature=0.0) -> normalized to max_tokens=800 + temperature dropped -> 48-char reply that would otherwise have been empty.
k3_as_custom_model.not_suitable_for: streaming chat, safety classifier, any call capping max_tokens under 800
